observed_root_cause.detail: Effigy deserialises [tasks.<name>.run] through ManifestManagedRun (crates/effigy-manifest/src/task_runtime.rs): a TOML array is ManifestManagedRun::Sequence(Vec<ManifestManagedRunStep>), i.e. a list of separate shell commands, not one argv vector. The staged manifest therefore ran `python3` with no arguments, then tried to execute the launcher script path directly as a shell command.
observed_root_cause.script_mode: git mode 100644 (not executable) for scripts/build_context_comparison.py at the pinned base 527ae622
observed_root_cause.effect: The admitted inner launcher never started: no admission check, no source clone, no Cargo/rustc, no image, no measurement.

second_seam_inferred_not_observed.detail: Effigy created .effigy/{locks,runtime,reports} inside the staged root during launch. The admitted inner launcher's validate_staged_session requires exactly the three staged entries and would refuse `staged_session` on the fourth entry.
second_seam_inferred_not_observed.status: inferred from the retained root, not observed at runtime because the run failed earlier at exec; the scoped correction must confirm and address it.
